about_the_game:
Soul's Remnant is an upcoming free to play 2D platformer MMORPG by Chaomoon, with a focus on social gameplay and exploration. Customize your skills with our classless system, team up with others, and defeat monsters, bosses, and dungeons together!

In this demo, you can experience a work in progress version of the game. Much of the game's functionality is included and ready for play, but some features are also still in development, and may or may not be implementing and/or fully functional during this demo.

Some includes features are:

  • 2D platformer MMORPG with a cute and colorful pixel art graphics style

  • Large world to explore with lots of monsters, bosses, dungeons, and secrets to find!

  • Classless skill system and various stats to build your character with

  • Lots of equipment of various rarities to find and upgrade

  • Challenging dungeons and bosses for your (and your friends) to conquer

  • Guild system with various perks for you and your guild to unlock

  • Full crafting and gathering system, with many recipes to unlock and items to craft

  • Comprehensive quest system that provides various fun missions to complete for rewards

  • Lots of player-driven and party-based content, such as parties, party grinding, housing, and player shops for a full player-driven economy!

  • Full soundtrack of 30+ originally composed songs, all written, composed, and produced by Chaomoon

We hope you'll enjoy this limited time demo, and enjoy your time in the world of Soul's Remnant!

short_description: Soul's Remnant is a 2D platformer MMORPG focused on social gameplay and exploration! Customize your character, and conquer dungeons and bosses in this mysterious world. Play with friends or make new ones - just watch out when night falls! This demo is an early look at the game.
